verdict.rationale: Retell's pricing page explicitly states pay-as-you-go pricing starting at $0 with no annual contracts, offers an interactive calculator to estimate approximate monthly cost by adjusting key parameters, and new accounts get $10 free trial credit to test before paying — directly enabling a founder to estimate call costs before committing. Community discussion also confirms a concrete per-minute rate (17¢/min) is being charged in practice, corroborating usage-based billing exists.  missing for 10: the per-minute rate itself is not shown in first-party docs (only inferred from a community comment), and there's no independent verification of the calculator's accuracy.
